purpose: Single acquisition status for the data needed to move MouldMaster from generic/public evidence to site-specific production interpretation without fabricating machine, mould, material, part or process values.

fields: MouldMaster exact-grade record link when available
validated min/nominal/max values for applicable process variables
evidence linking the window to this machine/mould/material/part combination
siteSpecificDataRequired.boundary: Supplier processing guidance is context only and must not be promoted to a site-validated production window.

fields: at least two numeric process signals

publicOrExternalGates.known: Lower-workpiece TXT data authoritatively declares pressure in bar, volume in cm3 and injection flow in cm3/s. Upper-workpiece public data names pressure target/actual, velocity, volume and state.
publicOrExternalGates.missing: Authoritative upper-workpiece pressure unit and state-code meanings.
publicOrExternalGates.rule: Do not transfer lower-workpiece pressure units to upper-workpiece data by inference.

publicOrExternalGates.known: The authoritative RWTH record advertises ExperimentalData.zip as OpenAccess and the existing repository delivery review records the archive route and provenance metadata.
publicOrExternalGates.missing: Actual ZIP bytes delivered successfully to the automated research client followed by archive fingerprinting and semantic validation.

publicOrExternalGates.known: Two mould-temperature and two cavity-pressure channels are already accepted.
publicOrExternalGates.missing: Authoritative delivered-data units/scaling and stable mapping for HydPressure, ScrewPosition and Analog Input[1]/[2].

publicOrExternalGates.known: Five publisher OPJU projects are already SHA-256 verified.
publicOrExternalGates.missing: Trusted Origin/OriginPro or validated Origin Viewer export and reconciliation.

siteContextCompleteOnlyWhen: machine, mould, material, part, process-window and quality-plan sections are source-backed
all required real-run columns are present
retained numeric evidence has authoritative engineering semantics
actuals are not confused with commands or setpoints
required sensors have calibration linkage or an explicit documented warning
quality results are linked to the relevant shot/cavity where the source supports that linkage
neverCountAsComplete: generic polymer-family processing ranges substituted for an exact grade
supplier guidance relabelled as a validated site process window
machine values guessed from model-family marketing material without exact configuration evidence
mould geometry or projected area inferred without a controlled source
publication-reported sample counts when payload bytes are not possessed and profiled
units or signal roles inferred merely because values look plausible

nextAction: Populate data/minimum-production-context-template.json from site-controlled documents, then import a prepared pilot run using the existing shot/data-dictionary/trace/event/calibration contracts.
